figures.finding: Taiwan's national languages are the natural languages and sign languages of its ethnic groups, all equal; films screened for profit must carry Chinese subtitles or Mandarin dubbing. No source gives the share of screen work made in Mandarin.

value.national: all natural and sign languages of Taiwan's ethnic groups (equal)
value.screening: Chinese subtitles or Mandarin dubbing required for commercial screening
value.basis: Development of National Languages Act Art. 3-4; Motion Picture Act Art. 17

sources.said: Article 3 “National language” as referred to in this Act shall mean the natural languages and sign languages used by the different ethnic groups in Taiwan. … Article 4 All national languages shall be equal;
Where motion pictures are screened for profit domestically, they shall meet standards for handicapped access, and include either Chinese subtitles or Mandarin dubbing.
